digest:
- Last-mile operating costs are outpacing revenue growth for surveyed fleets, highlighting margin pressure that validates Nirvana's telematics-based risk insights for helping operators control loss costs [1].
- An appeals court upheld an $815.8M benzene verdict against ExxonMobil, underscoring ongoing social inflation trends that continue to affect commercial liability lines [3].
- Vertafore launched AI agents to automate policy verification and management tasks, requiring Nirvana to monitor broker tech integrations so MGA distribution workflows remain compatible with agency tools [6].
